title: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model of simvastatin

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Institute for Theoretical Biology
creators.name: Bartsch, Florian

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Faculty of Life Sciences, Department of Biology, Institute of Theoretical Biology, Systems Medicine of the Liver; University of Stuttgart, Institute of Structural Mechanics and Dynamics in Aerospace Engineering; University of Southern Denmark, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine, Department of Public Health; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Lübeck, Germany

description:
This repository provides the simvastatin physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model: the oral absorption of simvastatin, its first pass metabolism by CYP3A4 in the intestine and the liver, its hydrolysis to the active simvastatin acid, the hepatic uptake of the acid by OATP1B1, the enterohepatic circulation and excretion of the metabolites and the inhibition of the HMG-CoA reductase with the lowering of the LDL cholesterol.
